name: Checkpoint
note: The angled D you liked, with a check mark cutting through it and breaking out the right side. Work gets finished and moves on.

name: Commit
note: The D is a real git graph: the stem is main, the curve is a feature branch that leaves and merges back. The green node is the commit being tracked.

name: Board
note: A heavy D holding three kanban columns that rise left to right. The last column, done, is green.

name: Forward
note: The Dunya Decoded overlap with D and T: a solid D tucked behind a bold T whose bar turns into an arrow. DevTrack keeps the team moving forward.

name: Prompt
note: A D with a terminal prompt (>_) inside. Anyone who codes reads it at a glance, and it stays clear at favicon size.
